answer: Reputation decay resists sybils: standing is not won once and kept, it erodes each epoch unless refreshed by genuine work, drying up like a vault left sealed. A fake farm can flash briefly, but every idle clone's weight thins toward nothing — old timber rotting — the instant it stops drawing fresh nectar of real contribution. Attackers must keep each of a thousand accounts busy forever, a one-time swarm becoming a permanent bill.
